thesis: Selective Insurance (Nasdaq: SIGI). Q3 2026 10-Q (filed 2026-10-23) read via WebFetch extraction of financial statements; MD&A not read. Q3 net premiums earned 1,180.2M (-2.0%), 9M 3,612.9M (+1.7%); 9M NI 355.7M (+14.3%), driven by net investment income 453.0M (+17%); derived GAAP combined ratio about 98.3% for 9M (own calculation). Reserve for losses 8,006M vs 7,225M at year-end (+10.8%). Equity 3,445.7M incl 200M preferred; common book about 55.0 per share; debt 901.5M. Close 103.25 (2026-11-20) x 58,996,229 shares = 6.09B = 11.9x TTM NI 510.9M, about 1.88x common book. Operating cash flow 1,193.9M TTM is insurance float, not owner earnings.
counterthesis: Underwriting margin is thin (combined ratio near 98%), so profit leans on investment income; reserves up 10.8% against premiums up 1.7% raises a reserve adequacy question not tested; premiums fell in Q3; equity fell 163M YTD (unrealized losses or buybacks, cause not read). Preferred dividends not deducted from TTM NI, so P/E is slightly understated.
